parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: UserIds
parameters.description: The account IDs. A maximum of 100 accounts can be queried.
